name: 25884-eagledecode-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (target) + yuhuili/EAGLE-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B (EAGLE draft head). NousResearch is the ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- same weights, not a substitution.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine; 17.7 GB of weights on one card.
architecture: Dense LlamaForCausalLM: 32 layers, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, vocab 128256, 8.03B params = 16.1 GB bf16. The draft head is a single-layer model of the same width, 1.55 GB, declaring max_position_embeddings 2048.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 20%, bounded at 240 requests (30 waves, 192 measured).
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, fixed shape: 512 prompt tokens and 512 output tokens with zero variance, greedy (temperature 0) with ignore_eos.
purpose: An 8B chat assistant with a draft model, serving eight concurrent users half-page prompts and replies on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM d7e34b4210fd (`git describe --tags` v0.11.0rc1-77-gd7e34b4210) on 1x H100 80GB HBM3.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

# Must stay on ONE line: the engine's reader takes this file line by line and skips
# indented ones, so re-blocking this value drops the key and the engine starts without it.
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle", "model": "yuhuili/EAGLE-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B", "num_speculative_tokens": 3}

# Forced by the draft head: its config.json declares max_position_embeddings 2048 and the
# engine clamps the drafter's usable length to min(draft, target).
max-model-len: 2048

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
